haikus.haiku:
Syrup drips at dawn
Stacks rise like soft clouds, gold bright
Flavors swirl in air
Happy #NationalPancakeDay from @Cl

Seeds scattered by hand
Golden blossoms bloom freely
Nature's gifts unfold
Happy #JohnnyAppleseedDay from @ClamBakeSanta

Midnight jazz hums bright
Gershwin smiles, notes rise, sweet soft
Moonlight waltzes slow
#HappyBirthdayGeorgeGers

Bright glow of candles
Softly music swirls in air
Joyful hearts sing bright
#HappyBirthdayOliviaNewtonJohn from @Clam

Silver glow drifts high
Night air hums with quiet stars
Moonlight paints warm waves
Happy #FullMoon from @ClamBakeSanta
